jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Systems Test Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description: Your Mission: As a Senior Mechanical Systems Test Engineer (all genders), you will be responsible for the development, implementation, and operation of the Flight Control System (FCS) test environment (“Iron Bird”) at VÆRIDION. You will lead a major engineering project with significant cost and program impact, ensuring the successful development of a fully integrated test rig that enables system integration, validation, and certification of the aircraft’s primary and secondary flight control system. You will work at the interface of mechanical systems, actuation, control, and system integration, contributing directly to the development and certification of electric aircraft. Your Day-to-Day: Test Strategy & System Responsibility Take ownership of the test concept and strategy for the Flight Control System (FCS). Define test requirements, architectures, and validation approaches for system-level testing. Ensure alignment of all test activities with development, safety of flight, and certification objectives. Iron Bird Development (Test Rig Project Leadership) Lead the development, implementation, and commissioning of the FCS Iron Bird test rig. Define system architecture, interfaces, and functional requirements of the test environment. Manage the development of mechanical, electrical, and control system integration within the test rig. Drive supplier selection, coordination, and technical oversight for test rig development (CAPEX project). Ensure delivery of the test rig within program timelines, budget, and technical requirements. Test Execution & System Validation Plan and execute system-level test campaigns on the Iron Bird. Ensure reliable, high-quality test data generation and reporting. Analyse system behaviour and support validation of flight control performance and safety. Support verification and certification activities. Test Asset Ownership Own the Iron Bird test asset, ensuring configuration control, readiness, and safe operation. Establish processes for operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the test rig. Ensure traceability and reproducibility of test configurations and results. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with flight controls, systems engineering, structures, and test teams. Interface with design engineers to ensure testability and integration readiness. Support integration of hardware, actuators, sensors, and control systems. Health, Safety & Compliance Promote and uphold a strong safety culture in all test activities. Ensure compliance with relevant safety standards, especially for complex mechanical systems. Establish risk assessments, safe operating procedures, and training for test operations. Your Profile: Degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related field. Extensive experience in testing and validation of complex mechanical or aerospace systems. Proven experience in developing test rigs or large-scale test environments. Experience in leading technical projects with high complexity and impact. Strong understanding of mechanical systems, actuation, and mechanical flight control architectures. Experience in system integration testing, ideally in aerospace applications. Experience with development of test rigs, Iron Birds, or similar system-level test environments. Knowledge of instrumentation, measurement systems, and data acquisition. Understanding of certification-driven testing and validation processes. Experience managing suppliers and external partners for engineering projects. Strong ownership mindset and ability to drive complex projects to completion. Excellent problem-solving and system-level thinking skills. Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities. Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment. Fluent in English, German is a plus. We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist. Why us? Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation. We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments. Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us. Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days. Become a part of our success with virtual stock options. Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket. Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability. jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As AI Automation Engineer, you will turn manual operations work across HR, finance, legal, sales and manufacturing into AI agents and automations running in production. You will sit next to internal users, map their painful processes and ship fast, with real users a few desks away. You will own your automations end to end and measure the time they save. Responsibilities Build AI agents and automations that remove manual work across HR, finance, legal, sales and manufacturing. Integrate core business systems (HR, contracts, CRM, PLM, ERP) through APIs, webhooks and syncs. Build internal tools when nothing on the market fits the need. Work directly with internal users to map their processes and decide what to automate first. Deliver a steady flow of quick wins, shipped in days rather than months. Ship to production early and track the time saved by each automation. Own the reliability of what you ship through tests, monitoring and documentation. Take ownership of a business domain end to end as your scope grows. Candidate Requirements 0 to 3 years of experience, with a degree from a top engineering school or an equivalent signal of excellence. Strong coding skills in Python and TypeScript, with a track record of fast, hands-on delivery. Proven record of building things on your own, such as side projects, hackathons, open source or a startup. Daily use of AI coding tools, with a concrete workflow you can describe. Curiosity about how the business works, and genuine care for the users you build for. Autonomy, speed and persistence in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment. Full commitment to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision and growth plans, with a willingness to go the extra mile. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Quality Engineer firmware IoT
jobs.description: Notre domaine Sport Products recherche un·e Quality Engineer firmware IoT en CDI basé·e à Lille. L'équipe "Augmented Products" est au cœur de l'innovation chez Decathlon. Notre mission ? Concevoir une stack technique complète, de l'objet connecté au Cloud, pour offrir une expérience sportive augmentée à nos utilisateurs mondiaux. Composée d'experts passionnés, notre équipe relève des défis technologiques majeurs liés à la scalabilité et à la fiabilité des données. En nous rejoignant, vous aurez un impact direct sur la manière dont des millions de sportifs interagissent avec leurs produits. TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION Tu conçois et déploies les stratégies de test automatisé et manuel pour valider la qualité et la fiabilité des firmwares IoT pour différentes catégories de produits et diverses architectures matérielles. Tu crées, exécutes et maintiens le référentiel des tests firmware (BLE, WiFi, LTE, CAN, OTA) sur bancs de test et environnements réels. Tu identifies, qualifies et suis la résolution des anomalies en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de développement firmware et produit. Tu garantis la conformité de la télémétrie, des services GATT et des protocoles de communication avec les spécifications établies. Tu participes à l'amélioration continue des processus QA et promeus la culture de la qualité au sein de l'équipe pluridisciplinaire. Tu participes à la définition et la promotion d’une approche Shift-Left en intégrant les exigences de testabilité dès la phase de conception et de cadrage des fonctionnalités avec les équipes Produit et Firmware. Tu conçois, construis et fais évoluer les outils, frameworks et bancs d'essai d'automatisation des tests pour réduire le besoins d’action manuelles, l'instabilité et la dépendance au matériel physique. CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS Organisation de travail hybride ; Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ; Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ; Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ; Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels). NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITÉ Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es. Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. En cas de besoin d'aménagement, tu peux en faire la demande via le formulaire de candidature, celle-ci sera confidentielle. Ces demandes n'affectent pas le résultat du processus de recrutement. DECATHLON DIGITAL Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits. Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
